name: The West Hollywood EDITION
insider_take: This sleek tower rises above the Sunset Strip like a modern beacon of luxury, where rock star glamour meets refined sophistication in the heart of WeHo's legendary nightlife scene.
whats_special: The West Hollywood EDITION occupies a prime spot on the world-famous Sunset Strip, featuring Ian Schrager's signature design aesthetic with floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning city and Hollywood Hills views. The rooftop pool and bar provide an exclusive perch above one of LA's most iconic boulevions, while the ground-level Sunset restaurant brings Michelin-starred dining to the strip.
pro_tip: Book a Sunset Strip King room on floors 15+ for unobstructed westward views – you'll catch epic sunsets over Beverly Hills and the Pacific beyond.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool scene at golden hour when the Strip comes alive below, and a nightcap at the lobby bar where you might spot celebrities heading to nearby hotspots like The Chateau Marmont or Soho House. The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of legendary venues like The Troubadour and Whisky a Go Go.
pros: Prime West Hollywood location with easy access to Sunset Strip entertainment
Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated urban aesthetic
Rooftop pool and bar with panoramic city views
High-end dining and nightlife venues on-site
cons: Limited parking availability in busy West Hollywood area
